Method of Attack: Injecting malicious code into legitimate Authorize.net payment gateway files for WooCommerce to steal credit card and personal information
Encrypting stolen payment details with AES-128-CBC and storing them in image files
Capturing additional payment details from input form elements
Abusing WordPress Heartbeat API to exfiltrate data stealthily
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious scripts into payment gateway module files
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 'wc-authorize-net-cim-credit-card-account-number' string in HTTP request body
Malicious code injected at the bottom of 'class-wc-authorize-net-cim.php'
Encrypted payment data stored in image files
